published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The users’ allocation shares were miscalculated, allowing the attacker to obtain more funds than they deserved by destroying NFTs.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Do not use dynamic totalVotingPower for allocation. Instead, record the initial totalVotingPower at the time of each distribution.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: Calculate the allocation ratio for each faction's NFTs based on the current totalVotingPower.
